Privacy & visit counts

Checking collection status…

If enabled, this site sends only a page label such as “orbit”, “story”, or “lab” to its aggregate counter when a page becomes visible. It does not send your images, drawings, file names, URL queries, full referrer, email, or visitor identifier. Requests omit cookies and credentials. The application stores minute-level counts, grouped into dates in Asia/Seoul. Hosting providers receive ordinary network requests.

Page views are not unique people. Reloads count again. Aggregate totals and daily graphs are public in the project README. Browser blockers, bots and network errors affect accuracy. Tracking starts only after activation; it cannot reconstruct earlier traffic.

Your choice

Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are respected. You can also opt out below. This preference uses only a local storage flag, shared by these GitHub Pages projects in this browser. It does not identify you.
